# CityQuiz.io

> > An interactive geography quiz game testing knowledge of cities across Europe, United States, Asia, and world regions.

CityQuiz.io offers educational geography challenges focused on identifying and learning about cities from multiple continents including Europe, North America, South America, Asia, Africa, and Australia. The platform provides an engaging way to improve geographical knowledge through interactive quizzes.

## Key Topics

- Geography Quiz
- City Quiz
- World Regions
- Educational Game

## Main Application

- [CityQuiz.io](https://cityquiz.io/): Geography quiz game covering cities in Europe, US, Asia and World regions
